title: Display bug in history
body:
Old bug, not new in 3.3.
**Steps to reproduce** :

1. Go to the history, change graph scale
2. Go back to main screen
3. Go back to history

**Bug** : 
The graph has the scale previously selected but the buttons are always 24h.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4d0047dd-48ac-48d1-8558-1baa273e1b83)

comments.body:
That's how it's designed. Scale in history is independent to scale on Overview because both screens have different purpose.
History always starts on 24h
I don't mind that it starts on 24h every time, but then the graph should be displayed with a 24h scale as well. The graph remains with the previously selected scale, but not the button.
